interactions.description: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) can mildly increase the body's own thyroid hormone production. When taken together with levothyroxine, a synthetic thyroid hormone, the combined effect may raise thyroid hormone levels more than intended, potentially causing symptoms of over‑replacement such as rapid heartbeat, anxiety, or weight loss.
interactions.recommendation: Do not stop either product on your own, but discuss the combination with your doctor. Your doctor may want to check your thyroid function tests more frequently and adjust the levothyroxine dose if needed. Taking them at different times of day does not eliminate the interaction, so medical guidance is essential.

interactions.overall_safety_summary: The combination of Ashwagandha and Levothyroxine is not contraindicated, but it can increase thyroid hormone activity and should be monitored. With medical supervision, the pair can be used safely.
interactions.recommendation: Schedule an appointment with your prescribing clinician to review your thyroid test results and confirm whether the current levothyroxine dose remains appropriate while you are using Ashwagandha.
interactions.disclaimer: This information is generated by an AI tool and does not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified pharmacist or physician, especially when a moderate or higher interaction is identified.
